ws_how_to_create: To create a new workspace (team), click the '+' (Create Workspace) button. Enter a name (e.g., Math Class 9-A), a short description, and your role (e.g., Teacher, Team Lead). Since you are the creator, you will automatically be assigned as an 'Admin'.
ws_how_to_create_buddy: Wanna gather your crew? Hit the '+' button. Throw in a name, description, and your role. You made it, so you're the boss (Admin) automatically, dude.
ws_how_to_invite: Now it's time to invite people! In the workspace detail screen, you will see an 'Invite Details' box. You can either copy the unique 8-character invite code or click 'Share Link' to send it directly via WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. Anyone who clicks the link or enters the code in the 'Join Workspace' screen will instantly join your team.
ws_how_to_invite_buddy: Time to round up the squad. Go to your workspace details, tap 'Share Link' and blast it on WhatsApp. Or just send them the 8-character code so they can join manually.
ws_how_to_assign: Once your team is assembled, click 'Assign New Task' to dispatch tasks to everyone or just selected members in seconds. Set the topic, target, and deadline. These tasks will appear in their personal calendars with a special '👥 Workspace Task' badge. (Note: If someone leaves the workspace, their completed tasks' performance stats are saved, but any pending workspace tasks are instantly removed from their calendar!)
ws_how_to_assign_buddy: Got the crew? Hit 'Assign New Task' and hand out the work! You can assign it to everyone or just specific folks. Your tasks will pop up in their calendars with a shiny badge. If someone bails, their finished work stats stay, but pending tasks vanish instantly.
